summary: Iteration 61 · Phase 3 Cycle C — ELF Analyzer validation gate. Backend pytest suite passed 13/13 (7 iter61 E2E + 6 ELF unit) plus 20/20 Artifact-Intelligence/PE/Office regression = 33/33 total. Live REST verification against /api/artifacts/analyze on a minimal ELF64 header returned artifact_type='elf', confidence=99, capability_available=true, detected_by=magic_matcher, and analysis={available, overview(elf_class=64, machine=EM_X86_64, type=ET_EXEC, entry_point=0x400000, abi=ELFOSABI_SYSV, endianness=little, is_dyn=false, file_size=64), hashes(md5+sha1+sha256), sections, segments, dynamic, symbols, notes, findings}. Findings surfaced correctly (statically_linked medium + stripped low). Regression: PE stub → artifact_type='pe', PDF header → 'pdf', .docx OOXML → 'office'. Truncated ELF (magic-only) returns 200 with controlled analysis, no 500. /api/decode/smart with base64-wrapped ELF returned 200 with verdict_card.verdict='Partial' and iedde_terminal_state='stability_gate' (routed_analysis not populated for this specific unwrapped-base64 case — allowed by test contract). /api/history filters (interpreter=powershell, terminal_state=binary_artifact_recovered) both return 200. /api/artifacts/capabilities lists all 4 analyzers (pe, pdf, office, elf) with available=true. Frontend smoke: admin login succeeded, DECODE ran on ELF b64 → status 'ANALYSIS COMPLETE · Suspicious', page rendered ELF-related text (4 occurrences) and Threat panels (5 occurrences); ThreatSummaryCard/ELFAnalysisPanel testids exist in JSX exactly as spec. Regression re-decode of PE payload updated the workspace state to a new completed analysis with input length changing accordingly.
critical_code_review_comments: ELF analyzer registered last in the artifact-intelligence registry — routing correctly still matches on ELF magic first; PE/PDF/Office fixtures unaffected (verified by regression tests).

analysis.analysis payload for ELF does not expose a dedicated top-level 'security' object; NX/PIE/RELRO/canary/exec-stack signals are collapsed into 'findings' (severity+code+title+detail) — consistent with Office analyzer pattern in iter60 and consumed by ThreatSummaryCard's severity→verdict derivation.

Preview environment observation (NOT a code bug): frontend polls a lot of LLM-backed endpoints on the workspace page; when multiple browser tabs are open the backend uvicorn worker gets saturated and localhost:8001 times out. `supervisorctl restart backend` clears it instantly. Consider throttling background polling in prod or using a separate LLM queue.
seed_data_creation: In-memory ELF64 header (struct.pack), minimal DOS+PE stub, %PDF-1.7 header, fabricated .docx via zipfile — none persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ELF analyzer is Cycle C-certified. test_iter61_elf_e2e.py (7 tests) doubles as regression suite for all 4 artifact types + capabilities endpoint. If backend appears hung during future runs, `sudo supervisorctl restart backend && sleep 12` reliably restores it — root cause is LLM-heavy background polling saturating the async loop while multiple browser tabs are open, not a functional defect. All other iter60 Office/PE/PDF regressions still green.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found. Only environmental fragility noted above.
